verdicts.reason: Both break the reading order: the 'Plan a Visit' CTA is pushed to the top-left corner above the logo, and the 'NOW OPEN' eyebrow ends up below the body copy. A also drops the architectural photo entirely, wraps the headline into three cramped lines and jams 'NOW OPEN' against the bottom edge. B keeps a thin strip of the photo for some fidelity, but that strip is a meaningless fragment, 'NOW OPEN' is so big it competes with the headline, and the headline sits tight against the body copy.
